preconditions.description: The number of test cases t must be between 1 and 1000.
For each test case, the range of cans l to r must be between 1 and 10^9.

postconditions.expression: stdout == 'YES' if any(a for a in range(l, r + 1) if (x % a) >= a / 2) else 'NO'
postconditions.description: Output 'YES' if there exists a pack size a such that for all x in the range [l, r], the customer buys more cans than initially wanted; otherwise, output 'NO'.
